scheme_name: PM DevINE – PM Development Initiative for NE Region
overview: PM-DevINE, a Central Sector scheme launched in Union Budget 2022-23 with ₹6,600 crore outlay (2022-26), aims to accelerate sustainable development in the North-East through infrastructure, social projects, livelihood generation, and bridging sectoral gaps.
objectives: Accelerate sustainable development in the North-East
Develop infrastructure in water, power, connectivity, tourism, education, and health
eligibility: State Governments of the eight North-Eastern States submit complete and accurate project proposals in the prescribed formats with all supporting documents and clearances through the Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal.
benefits: Full central funding for approved projects, financial support for infrastructure and social development, livelihood generation, and bridging sectoral gaps in the North Eastern Region.
financial_support: The scheme provides grants for creation of capital assets and grants-in-aid-general to State Governments and implementing agencies for projects under PM-DevINE, with funds released after approval by the Expenditure Finance Committee (EFC) and issue of Administrative Approval and Financial Sanction (AFS).
application_process: 1. Submission of complete proposal in prescribed format with documents as per guidelines of PM-DevINE. 2. Projects are submitted by State Government through Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal. 3. State Government (SLEC) -> MDoNER -> Comments of Line Ministries/Departments - MDoNER(EIMC) -> AFS issue -> Implementation by Implementing agency/State Govt. 4. (i) Preliminary examination and circulation of the complete proposal for comments: 15 days. (ii) Comments on Concept Note from Line Ministries/ NITI Aayog: 15 days. (iii) Comments on DPR from Line Ministries/ NITI Aayog: 30 days. (iv) Submission of the proposal for EIMC consideration after completion of inter-ministerial consultation: 30 days. (v) Issue of Minutes of the EIMC meeting after conduct of the meeting: 15 days. (vi) Issue of AFS after all approvals and clearances are in place: 15 days.
required_documents: Supporting documents as per guidelines of PM-DevINE
implementing_agency: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
contact_details: Shri S.D. Meena, Director, PM-DevINE, Tel: 011-21410599, Email: meena.sd@nic.in
caveats: Projects must be submitted by State Governments through the Purvottar Vikas Setu Portal
Financial sanction is issued only after all approvals and clearances are in place
Implementation is carried out by the implementing agency or State Government after AFS issue
